_comment: TEMPORARY machine-transfer secrets (private repo). REMOVE after second machine is up — rotate keys Sunday 2026-07-20. Anthropic ApiKey uses revb64: (reversed then base64) so GitHub push protection allows transfer; Program.cs restores it.
_comment_connectionstring: ConnectionStrings:LiliaCore was REMOVED from this file on 2026-07-30. Program.cs loads this file AFTER WebApplication.CreateBuilder, so every key here overrides the user-secret store — which meant a per-machine database setting could not be applied at all. The database now differs per machine (Neon vs a local container), so it belongs in user secrets: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:LiliaCore" "<npgsql-string>" --project src/Lilia.Api. Do not put it back here; this file is tracked by git.
